name: Medallion Lords
description: The Medallion Lords were a street gang based in the Marcy and Sumner Projects area of Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, active during the 1950s and early 1960s. They were tightly allied with the Stompers and Imperial Lords, forming a three-gang bloc that shared turf near JHS 57. The alliance initially included the Buccaneers, but broke down around 1960 over a territorial dispute at PS 59 in the Sumner Projects. The resulting war was among the most violent in the area; in 1961, the Buccaneers and their affiliate gang the Tiny Tims killed three members across the Stompers, Medallion Lords, and Imperial Lords.

sources.title: Marcy, Sumner and a Nest of Youth Gangs | New York City Fighting Gangs
